verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Logseq as 'privacy-first, open-source' and local-first, implying no telemetry infrastructure exists, but there is no explicit documentation of a telemetry/usage-tracking feature or an opt-out setting for it. Absence of concrete evidence of an actual telemetry toggle means this cannot be confirmed as full/partial delivery.
